forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
This week, 4 survey teams and 4 clearance teams were active. Work finished included 1 zone survey, 1 visit and 1 clearance. 2 zones, CHI-Z31 and ECV-Z17, were declared free. So far, 17 zones have been surveyed and 4 declared free; 13 areas have been released and 7 cleared.

No teams were stood down or had reports missing for more than a week. 11 zones are closed according to the access feed. No dossiers or reports were held; 1 report was queried. No new plan was approved, so work remains under P06.

The forecast, made in week 23 for the zones of the plan it was made with, counting what is already done, gives a P10 to P90 range of 10 to 14 mine areas cleared this season and 7 to 11 zones declared free.
